about_the_game:
Destiny of Immortal transports you to a mystical world of cultivation, offering a unique blend of Roguelike mechanics, open-world exploration, and rich narrative choices.

Artifacts of Creation

A Cultivation Saga Centered Around Ultimate Power At the dawn of the universe, several Artifacts of Creation were born, each possessing heaven-defying powers. These artifacts channel the very essence of the cosmos, possessing their own sentience and indestructibility. Any cultivator who masters an Artifact of Creation is destined to dominate their realm and become a supreme being. However, these artifacts are fickle; upon their master's fall, they flee into the vastness of space, drifting until they find their next destined owner.

In Destiny of Immortal, you are that destined soul. Guided by one of these mysterious artifacts, you will embark on a legendary journey of ascension.

Free Exploration

An Open, Unbounded World Experience true freedom in your pursuit of the Dao. Destiny of Immortal features a narrative-driven open world teeming with dynamic events and hidden plots. Whether you choose to roam the mortal realms or explore spiritual mountains, your adventure is yours to define.

Multiple Endings

Your Choices Determine Your Fate The story evolves based on your decisions. Every choice you make ripples through the world, leading you down different paths of destiny. With multiple endings available, you must choose carefully and cultivate diligently to achieve the outcome you desire.

Infinite Possibilities

Deep Customization and Combat Synergies Through victory over powerful foes, stroke of luck, or unexpected encounters, you will acquire a vast array of martial arts and magical spells. Success lies in your ability to strategize: strictly combine these techniques to create powerful synergies (Builds) that will make even the most terrifying enemies tremble before your might.

In the world of Destiny of Immortal, explore boundless mountains and seas, forge alliances with diverse companions, and weave your own legend of immortality!

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mac OS X 10.11 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3210M (2 * 2500)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 530
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Mac OS X 10.11 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3210M (2 * 2500)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 6000
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
